THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Four little machines that make worksheets.

Pick a machine, choose your options, shuffle until it feels right — then solve it on the screen, print it, or save it as a picture. Every sheet is built right here in your browser: nothing is uploaded, and the machines even work offline once the page has loaded.

Word search maker

Hide our class words — or your own list — in a letter grid. Solve it on screen or print it for the table.

Open the machine →

Math practice maker

Adding and take-away sheets tuned to your child’s level, with an answer page for the grown-up. Tap the answers on screen too.

Open the machine →

Tracing sheet maker

Letters, numbers, class words and the proudest name in the house — trace on paper, or trace with a finger right on the screen.

Open the machine →

Matching pairs maker

Draw the line between helpers and their tools, animals and their homes — or match the pairs by tapping on screen.

Open the machine →
FOR GROWN-UPS

How the machines work.

Each machine starts from the words and numbers our classes actually teach: the habitat animals from Class 36, the helpers from Class 33, the weather words from Class 34. Shuffle deals a fresh sheet from the same options, so siblings can each get their own. Solve on screen turns the sheet into a gentle game — tap the letters, tap the answers, connect the pairs — and print or save as picture put it on paper for the kitchen table and the fridge door.

Printed worksheets never mark anything complete in My Classroom — paper is for tables, kitchens and fridge doors. The on-screen versions are just for fun, and they collect nothing: no name, no score board, no account.
